name: Find by Text
description: Finds what you name in words and gives a box around each match, in the picture's pixels. Wire Boxes to the Box input of Segment by Points or Box to get the mask of what the words name (one object per box, joined in one mask); Preview shows what was found. GroundingDINO tiny through ONNX Runtime.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A GroundingDINO ONNX file. The picker offers the downloads, with their licence shown first.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: What to find, in a few words: red balloon. For several things separate them with periods, commas or lines: cat, dog. A short noun phrase works best (the clown, a red mug).

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.label: Threshold
inputs.description: How sure the model must be, from 0 to 1. Lower finds more (and more wrong ones), higher keeps only the clear matches. Preview shows each match with its score.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.label: Most matches
inputs.description: Keep only this many matches, the best first. 0 keeps every match above Threshold.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Auto uses the GPU when the pack's environment has the CUDA build of ONNX Runtime.

outputs.name: boxes
outputs.label: Boxes
outputs.description: One line per match, best first: x1 y1 x2 y2 in the picture's pixels. Empty when nothing matched.

outputs.name: preview
outputs.label: Preview
outputs.description: The picture with each match's box, phrase and score.
